summary_en: 800,000 shares (6.40% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥1.2B. Execution window: 6 Aug 2026 to 31 Mar 2027. Methods: open-market purchase on Tokyo Exchange and ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange). Rationale: capital efficiency improvement and shareholder returns under balance of growth investment, financial strength, and capital returns.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. announced on 5 August 2026 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 800,000 ordinary shares (6.40% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥1.2 billion. Acquisition will occur between 6 August 2026 and 31 March 2027 via two methods: open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and off-exchange transactions under ToSTNeT-3. The company states the rationale as improving capital efficiency and achieving optimal capital structure, while delivering shareholder returns through a balanced approach to growth investment, financial strength, and capital returns. Management emphasizes cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious management as key corporate objectives.
